verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is a 3D rendering and game engine library, not an agent or AI application that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product role. The only MCP-related evidence covers the absence of an MCP server ecosystem, which is a different, server-side story and does not make this client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
